workflow: Update Postman (full body) BEFORE asking user for approval
Ask user: هل تمام؟ then next task

cloudSync.afterLocalEdit: Run: php scripts/sync-postman-ids.php (cloud export) postman/One.postman_collection.json postman/One.postman_collection.synced.json then putCollection via Postman MCP (collectionId above). Local JSON alone does not update the Postman app.

conventions.preferPutCollection: Use Postman Collection v2.1 PUT (not legacy createCollectionRequest) so Body renders in the app. MUST sync to cloud after editing postman/One.postman_collection.json.
conventions.jsonRequests: body.mode raw + body.raw JSON + Content-Type application/json
conventions.multipartRequests: body.mode formdata + body.formdata[] with type text|file and sample values
